summary: NON-HOT-LANE PROJECT: Daily Operating Brief substrate map
body: Kimi Claw, take this as a substantial non-hot-lane project. Stay strictly read-only against source/runtime. Do not edit code, tests, dashboard/API, ontology, memory, provider/routing, AgentRunner, TelicSeam, opportunity_dispatcher, telos_gates.py, or dharma_kernel.py. Do not create product surfaces. Your lane is research/synthesis only, with mailbox response as the artifact. Mission: map the existing substrate for a future Daily Operating Brief / self-funding cockpit. Find evidence paths and contracts for: AgentOps reports, roaming mailbox responses, insight_brief.py, SWARM_HOT_ITEMS.md, cost_tracker.py, economic_engine.py, economic_spine.py, ValueEvent, Contribution, YDS, ForgeScore, quality_forge, revenue/wedge/burn/token spend, stop-doing signals, and integration-candidate signals. Deliverable: respond in roaming_mailbox with structured JSON. Required top-level keys: callsign, status, utc_time, model, received_task_id, non_hot_lane_confirmed, evidence_paths, substrate_map, missing_objects, risks, stop_doing_items, proposed_next_project, allowed_files_for_next_project, gates_for_next_project, one_sentence_next_roi. Make proposed_next_project something you can actually work on without hot files: preferably docs/report-only or mailbox/report-only. Include exact files you inspected and rank the top 5 next moves by ROI. This task was sent 2026-05-05T00:05:53Z on converge/kimi-claw-registration-20260428.
